$comment: Machine-readable protocol constants. This file is the single source of truth for tag values, score bounds and byte lengths. Specifications state the rules; this file states the values. A change here is a protocol version change per SPEC-010.
opReturnTagsComment: Push-only ASCII tags. lengthBytes is the byte length of the tag itself, which determines the direct-push opcode it is encoded with.

scoreRange.$comment: SPEC-004 RF-04. Values outside this range are NOT dropped: the fact is emitted with valid=false. See SPEC-009 RF-W08.

encodedRange.$comment: The encoded form is a single unsigned byte, so a malformed or out-of-range value can still be 0-255.

fieldLengths.$comment: Byte lengths of the fixed-width protocol fields. All are rendered as lowercase hex in facts.

contracts.$comment: Verified with cashc 0.13.2. WARNING: the 'fingerprint' the compiler emits is NOT a conformance anchor. Empirically it does not change when the contract's logic changes: editing `require(tx.outputs.length == 2)` to `== 3` altered the compiled bytecode, the embedded source and the debug bytecode, while the fingerprint stayed identical. It is recorded here for traceability only. Conformance is established by tools/check-artifacts.mjs, which recompiles each source and compares the full artifact (mnemonic bytecode, ABI, embedded source, debug bytecode) against the committed one.

outOfScope.$comment: Values that are often mistaken for protocol constants but belong to the application layer. They MUST NOT be added to this file.
outOfScope.DEFAULT_IDENTITY_COLLATERAL: application default (demo server), not a protocol invariant
outOfScope.reputationWeights: interpretation layer, see SPEC-007 in the demo repository
outOfScope.confidenceIndex: interpretation layer, see SPEC-007 in the demo repository
